game.sliding.seo_desc:
About Sliding Puzzle

Sliding Puzzle is a classic brain teaser where the goal is to rearrange a scrambled set of numbered tiles in order by sliding them into the empty space. This game not only tests your spatial logic but also trains your hand-eye coordination and reaction speed.

How to Play

Click on any tile adjacent to the empty space to slide it into that space. Use this single empty spot to maneuver the tiles until all numbers are neatly ordered from left to right, top to bottom.

Game Features

  • Multiple grid sizes (4x4, 5x5, 6x6) to suit different skill levels.
  • Real-time multiplayer PK mode to race against players worldwide.
  • Detailed statistics to track your best time and minimum moves.

Start your challenge now and see if you can break the world record for the fastest solve!

game.sokoban.seo_desc:
About Classic Sokoban

Sokoban is a classic puzzle game that challenges your logic and spatial imagination. You must control the worker to push all the boxes precisely to their designated target locations within a maze-like warehouse.

How to Play

Use swipe or click to move the worker. The worker can only push boxes, not pull them, and only one box can be pushed at a time. Because the maze is tight, one wrong move can trap a box in a dead corner, resulting in an unsolvable puzzle. Every move requires careful thinking!

Game Features

  • Thousands of levels ranging from easy to mind-bending, perfect for players of all ages.
  • Undo function provides room for trial and error.
  • Multiplayer PK mode allows you to race against friends to see who can solve the puzzle with fewer moves or in less time.

Engage your brain and challenge yourself to find the perfect route to solve these complex warehouse puzzles!
game.block.seo_desc:
About Block Puzzle

This is a casual puzzle game combining the classic Tetris mechanics with jigsaw elements. You need to place blocks of various shapes onto the grid, filling entire rows or columns to clear them and score points.

How to Play

Drag the randomly generated blocks from the bottom and place them on the 8x8 or 10x10 board. Since blocks cannot be rotated, you must plan ahead. The game ends when there is no longer enough space to place a new block.

Game Features

  • Endless Mode and Challenge Mode for pure combo satisfaction.
  • Multiplayer online battles where the last player surviving wins.
  • Beautiful interface and smooth animations, perfect for passing time and training spatial planning skills.
game.codebreaker.seo_desc:
About Codebreaker

Codebreaker (similar to Mastermind) is a highly challenging logical deduction game. You must guess the correct sequence of color codes within a limited number of attempts using the clues provided by the system.

How to Play

After each guess, the system provides two types of clues: black pegs mean both color and position are correct, while white pegs mean the color is correct but in the wrong position. Use logical deduction based on these clues to narrow down the possibilities until you crack the final code.

Game Features

  • Multiple difficulty tiers, from simple 4-color codes to complex 6-color codes.
  • Trains your logical deduction and process of elimination skills.
  • Global leaderboards and online speedrun mode available.
game.drop2048.seo_desc:
About Drop 2048

This is an innovative number synthesis game merging the core mechanics of Tetris and 2048. Continuously dropping number blocks await your clever placement and quick reflexes.

How to Play

Control the position of number blocks dropping from the top. When two blocks with the same number collide, they merge into a single block with double the value (e.g., two 2s merge into a 4). The goal is to synthesize 2048 or even larger numbers and score as high as possible.

Game Features

  • Fast-paced synthesis experience testing split-second decision-making.
  • Rich combo system delivering satisfying elimination feedback.
  • Multiplayer PK mode where you can send garbage blocks to your opponent!
game.gomoku.seo_desc:
About Gomoku

Gomoku is an ancient Chinese pure strategy board game for two players, featuring simple rules but infinite variations. Black and white alternate turns, and the first to form an unbroken chain of five pieces horizontally, vertically, or diagonally wins.

How to Play

Played on a 15x15 board, Black plays first and White second. A line of five continuous pieces of your color secures victory. High-level matches often unfold in the subtle concealment of intent and counterattacks from defense.

Game Features

  • Built-in powerful AI opponents ranging from beginner to master level.
  • Online matchmaking and playing with friends for pure mental combat.
  • Detailed match records and spectator mode to help you review and improve your skills.
game.hexa.seo_desc:
About Hexa Puzzle

Hexa Puzzle is a visually distinct elimination game. Compared to traditional square grids, the hexagonal grid offers three dimensions of elimination, providing more freedom and strategic depth.

How to Play

Drag the provided hexagonal block pieces onto the large hexagonal board. When a full line in any of the three directions (horizontal or the two diagonals) is completely filled, that line is eliminated. Efficient space utilization is the key to high scores.

Game Features

  • Omnidirectional elimination experience that is easy to pick up but hard to master.
  • Cool combo elimination visual effects.
  • Supports competitive ranking against players worldwide.
game.idiom.seo_desc:
About Idiom Solitaire

Idiom Solitaire is an entertaining and educational word game based on Chinese cultural heritage. By filling in characters to complete four-character idioms, you can experience the profoundness of traditional Chinese culture while expanding your vocabulary.

How to Play

Based on the text clues on the board, fill in the correct Chinese characters in the blank squares so that all horizontal and vertical word groups form valid four-character idioms. You can use hints if you get stuck.

Game Features

  • Massive idiom database, covering everything from common phrases to obscure historical references.
  • Not just for fun; you can also view the definitions and origins of idioms, learning as you play.
  • Daily challenges and multiplayer speedword modes.
game.lightsout.seo_desc:
About Lights Out

Lights Out is a classic electronic puzzle game. Its incredibly simple rules can evolve into countless complex board states, making it a favorite among math and logic enthusiasts.

How to Play

Clicking a lightbulb will toggle its state (on to off, off to on) as well as the states of the four adjacent lightbulbs (up, down, left, right). Your goal is to turn off all the lights on the board in the fewest possible moves.

Game Features

  • Offers 5x5 and larger grid challenges.
  • Tests deep logical reasoning and topological thinking.
  • Every puzzle is guaranteed to be solvable—see who can finish in the fewest moves!
game.math24.seo_desc:
About Math 24

Math 24 is a classic mental arithmetic game, perfectly recreating the card game that was once a nationwide sensation. It is an excellent tool for exercising mental math, reaction speed, and divergent thinking.

How to Play

The system will provide 4 numbers. You must use addition (+), subtraction (-), multiplication (×), division (÷), and parentheses to calculate exactly 24 using these 4 numbers. Each number must be used exactly once.

Game Features

  • All randomly generated puzzles are guaranteed solvable with dynamically adjusting difficulty.
  • Online buzzer mode to compete with friends and see whose mental math is faster!
  • Built-in multi-solution hints to help you break through mental blocks.
game.minesweeper.seo_desc:
About Minesweeper

Minesweeper is a globally beloved classic single-player game that popularized alongside personal computers. It perfectly blends logical deduction with a touch of luck, offering enduring appeal.

How to Play

Click squares to reveal the grid. If you reveal a mine, the game is over. If you reveal a number, it indicates how many mines are hidden in the surrounding 8 squares. Use these numerical clues to logically deduce the locations of all mines and place flags on them.

Game Features

  • Classic Beginner, Intermediate, and Expert difficulty grids.
  • Smart first-click protection ensuring you never die on the very first move.
  • Multiplayer speed-sweeping mode—find out who the true bomb disposal expert is!
game.sudoku.seo_desc:
About Classic Sudoku

Sudoku is a globally popular number-placement puzzle game. It requires no complex mathematics, relying entirely on logical deduction, making it an excellent brain workout.

How to Play

Fill the 9x9 grid with digits from 1 to 9 so that each column, each row, and each of the nine 3x3 subgrids contain all of the digits from 1 to 9 exactly once, with no repetitions or omissions.

Game Features

  • Multiple difficulties from beginner to extreme, with every puzzle guaranteed to have a unique solution.
  • Supports helpful features like note-taking, smart hints, and identical number highlighting.
  • Pioneering multiplayer mode: Speed Run and Grid Snatch modes make Sudoku a social experience!
game.tetris.seo_desc:
About Tetris

Tetris is the greatest evergreen classic in video game history, building the childhood memories of millions through the simple falling of geometric blocks.

How to Play

Control the falling blocks of various shapes and arrange them to form complete horizontal lines at the bottom. Once a line is completely filled, it clears and scores points. As your score increases, blocks fall faster until the screen is full.

Game Features

  • Perfect recreation of classic controls, supporting soft drop and hard drop.
  • Intense multiplayer battle mode: clearing multiple lines sends garbage lines to your opponent!
  • Minimalist UI and highly satisfying combo feedback.
game.watersort.seo_desc:
About Water Sort Puzzle

Water Sort Puzzle is a relaxing, stress-relieving yet challenging color sorting game. Watching chaotic colors gradually become pure offers immense psychological satisfaction.

How to Play

Tap any tube to pour the water inside into another tube. The rule is: you can only pour water if it matches the color of the top layer of the target tube, and if the target tube has enough space. The ultimate goal is to have only one color of water in each tube.

Game Features

  • Massive level library with gradually increasing difficulty, adding more tubes and colors.
  • No time limits, perfect for relaxing your brain anywhere, anytime.
  • Multiplayer competitive mode to see whose sorting logic is clearer and more efficient.

legal.privacy.content:
# Privacy Policy

**Effective Date: June 2026**

Welcome to Puzzle PK. Your privacy is critically important to us. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information when you use our website, games, and related services.

## 1. Information We Collect

We strive to collect only the absolute minimum amount of data required to operate the platform.

* **Account Information**: When you register, we collect a username and a securely hashed password. We do not require your real name or email address for basic gameplay.
* **Gameplay Data**: We store your high scores, game progress, match history, and unlocked achievements so you can track improvement over time.
* **Technical Data**: We temporarily log your IP address and connection timestamps solely for the purpose of maintaining server stability, preventing DDoS attacks, and ensuring fair play during real-time multiplayer matches (PK mode).

## 2. How We Use Your Information

* To provide, maintain, and improve our gaming platform.
* To manage your user account and authenticate your logins securely.
* To display global leaderboards and matchmaking rankings.
* To detect and prevent cheating, abuse, or other violations of our Terms of Service.
* To send you important service-related notifications (we do not send marketing emails).

## 3. Data Sharing and Disclosure

We **do not** sell, rent, or trade your personal information to third parties. Your data is strictly used for operating Puzzle PK. We may share anonymous, aggregated gameplay statistics (e.g., "10,000 matches of Sudoku played today") publicly, but this will never contain identifiable information.

## 4. Advertising & Google AdSense Cookies

To keep our games **100% free**, Puzzle PK displays advertisements provided by **Google AdSense** and other third-party advertising networks.

**How it works:**
* Google AdSense uses cookies and similar tracking technologies to collect information about your visits to this and other websites in order to show you relevant advertisements.
* The **DoubleClick cookie** and other advertising cookies may be set by Google on your device when you visit our site. These cookies track which ads you have seen and allow Google to serve ads tailored to your interests.
* We do **not** have direct access to the data collected by these advertising cookies.

**Your choices:**
* You can **opt out of personalised advertising** by visiting [Google's Ads Settings](https://adssettings.google.com/).
* You can also opt out via the [Network Advertising Initiative opt-out page](http://optout.networkadvertising.org/) or manage cookies directly in your browser settings.
* Opting out does not remove ads entirely — it means ads will no longer be tailored to your interests.

For more information on how Google uses data when you use our site, please visit: [How Google uses information from sites or apps that use our services](https://policies.google.com/technologies/partner-sites).

## 5. Cookies

We use the following types of cookies:

| Type | Purpose | Duration |
|------|---------|----------|
| Session Cookie | Keep you logged in | Browser session |
| Preference Cookie | Remember your theme/language | 1 year |
| Analytics Cookie (Google) | Understand traffic patterns | 2 years |
| Advertising Cookie (Google AdSense) | Serve relevant ads | Up to 2 years |

You can disable cookies in your browser settings at any time. Please note that disabling cookies may affect the functionality of our website and game features.

## 6. Data Security

We implement industry-standard security measures, including bcrypt password hashing and SSL/TLS encryption for all data transmitted between your browser and our servers. However, no internet transmission is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

## 7. Children's Privacy

Our games are designed to be enjoyed by users of all ages, including children. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13 without parental consent. If you believe your child has provided personal information on our site, please contact us at **contact@puzzlepk.com** so we can promptly delete it.

## 8. Your Rights

You have the right to request the deletion of your account and associated gameplay data at any time. To do so, please contact us at **contact@puzzlepk.com** or use the account deletion feature in the settings panel.

## 9. Changes to this Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated "Effective Date." We encourage you to review this page periodically.

## 10. Contact Us

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please contact us at: **contact@puzzlepk.com**

## 6. Disclaimer of Warranties
Our services are provided strictly on an "AS IS" and "AS AVAILABLE" basis. We do not guarantee uninterrupted access, error-free gameplay, or the permanent retention of your high scores and game data.

legal.about.title: About X-Game
legal.about.content:
X-Game is an open-source, free-to-play online logic puzzle platform dedicated to providing players with high-quality brain training and immersive gaming experiences.

## Our Vision

We believe that games are not just for entertainment, but powerful tools for sharpening the mind and fostering connections. X-Game places a special emphasis on **parent-child interaction** and **logic education**. With carefully crafted levels and clean, eye-friendly interfaces, we offer a relaxing space for adults to unwind and a stimulating environment for children to improve their spatial imagination and logical reasoning.

## Core Features

*   **For All Ages**: From simple connecting puzzles to brain-burning Sudoku, catering to all age groups.
*   **Parent-Child PK Mode**: Unique competitive rooms allow parents and children to engage in fair, logical battles across devices.
*   **Pure Experience**: We guarantee a clean game interface. Minimal ads are only used to cover basic server costs and will never disrupt your core gameplay.
*   **Open Source**: The project is entirely open-source. We welcome developers to contribute and build a better gaming ecosystem together.

Thank you for choosing X-Game. Let's discover the joy of thinking together!

tutorial.mine.goal_desc: Reveal all safe cells without hitting any mines. The numbers tell you how many mines are adjacent.
tutorial.mine.reveal_desc: Left-click (or tap) a cell to reveal it. The first click is always safe — a blank area will open up.
tutorial.mine.flag_desc: Right-click (or long-press) to place a flag on a suspected mine. Flags prevent accidental reveals.
tutorial.mine.numbers_desc: A number shows how many mines touch that cell. Use them to deduce which cells are safe and which are mines.
tutorial.mine.hint_desc: Stuck? Tap the 💡 Hint button — it safely reveals one guaranteed-safe cell for you.
tutorial.sudoku.goal_desc: Fill a 9×9 grid so every row, column, and 3×3 box contains the digits 1–9 exactly once.
tutorial.sudoku.rules_desc: No digit can repeat in the same row, column, or 3×3 box. Tap a cell and then tap a number to fill it in.
tutorial.sudoku.notes_desc: Enable Notes mode to jot down possible digits in a cell without committing. Great for narrowing down candidates.
tutorial.sudoku.hint_desc: Tap 💡 Hint to reveal one correct digit. Hints use a limited pool — use them wisely!
tutorial.math24.goal_desc: Use all four numbers on the card with any combination of + − × ÷ to make exactly 24.
tutorial.math24.ops_desc: You can use addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division. Parentheses are applied automatically.
tutorial.math24.select_desc: Tap a number, then tap an operator, then tap another number. Keep combining until you reach 24!
tutorial.math24.timer_desc: Solve as fast as possible to earn maximum stars and XP. Can't solve it? Try Shuffle for a new puzzle.
tutorial.codebreaker.goal_desc: Guess the secret code within the allowed number of attempts. Each guess reveals clues about your accuracy.
tutorial.codebreaker.feedback_desc: 🟢 Green = correct digit in the right position. 🟡 Yellow = correct digit in the wrong position. ⚫ Grey = digit not in the code.
tutorial.codebreaker.strategy_desc: Start with digits that cover many possibilities. Use the clues from each guess to eliminate options.
tutorial.codebreaker.hint_desc: Stuck? Tap 💡 to reveal one correct digit in its exact position. Use hints wisely!
tutorial.watersort.goal_desc: Sort all the colored liquids so each tube contains only one color. All tubes must be pure!
tutorial.watersort.select_desc: Tap a tube to select it (it will lift up), then tap another tube to pour the top color into it.
tutorial.watersort.rules_desc: You can only pour onto a matching color or into an empty tube. You can't pour if the destination is full.
tutorial.watersort.hint_desc: Tap 💡 to see the next recommended pour. Great for when you feel stuck!
tutorial.sokoban.goal_desc: Push all the boxes (📦) onto the target spots (★). When a box lands on a target it turns dark.
tutorial.sokoban.controls_desc: Swipe or tap the directional arrows to move the character. On desktop you can also use arrow keys or WASD.
tutorial.sokoban.rules_desc: Boxes can be pushed but not pulled. Plan ahead — pushing a box into a corner with no target is a dead end!
tutorial.sokoban.undo_desc: Tap ↩ to undo your last move. Tap 💡 for a hint. Both are limited per puzzle, so use them wisely.
tutorial.sliding.goal_desc: Arrange the numbered tiles in order from top-left to bottom-right, leaving the blank space at the end.
tutorial.sliding.move_desc: Tap any tile adjacent to the blank space to slide it in. Only tiles directly next to the gap can move.
tutorial.sliding.strategy_desc: Solve the puzzle row by row from the top. Avoid disturbing rows you've already completed while working on lower ones.
tutorial.sliding.hint_desc: Stuck? Tap 💡 to get a recommended move and find the right direction.
tutorial.tetris.goal_desc: Stack falling pieces to complete full rows — completed rows clear automatically and earn you points. Don't let pieces reach the top!
tutorial.tetris.controls_desc: Swipe left/right to move, swipe up or tap to rotate, swipe down to speed up, double-tap to drop. On desktop use arrow keys.
tutorial.tetris.scoring_desc: Clear multiple rows at once for a massive bonus: 2 rows ×3, 3 rows ×5, 4 rows (Tetris!) ×8.
tutorial.tetris.strategy_desc: Keep your stack flat and fill holes early. Save I-pieces for Tetris clears to maximise your score.
tutorial.hexa.goal_desc: Place hexagonal pieces on the board. Fill complete rows or diagonals to clear them and score points.
tutorial.hexa.place_desc: Drag a piece from the tray at the bottom and drop it onto the board. A preview highlights where it will land.
tutorial.hexa.clear_desc: Clearing multiple lines at once triggers a combo for multiplied points. The more you clear together, the bigger the reward!
tutorial.hexa.end_desc: The game ends when none of the three tray pieces can fit anywhere on the board. Manage your space wisely!
tutorial.gomoku.goal_desc: Be the first to connect five stones in a row — horizontally, vertically, or diagonally.
tutorial.gomoku.turn_desc: Players alternate placing one stone per turn on any empty intersection. Black moves first.
tutorial.gomoku.defense_desc: Block your opponent's four-in-a-row immediately. Look for double-three or double-four threats to force a win.
tutorial.gomoku.ai_desc: In single-player mode choose Easy, Medium, or Hard AI. Hard AI plans several moves ahead — start with Easy to practice!
tutorial.drop2048.goal_desc: Drop numbered balls and merge matching ones to double their value. Chain merges to reach 2048 and beyond for the highest score!
tutorial.drop2048.drop_desc: Tap or click a column to drop the current ball there. A preview line shows exactly where it will land.
tutorial.drop2048.merge_desc: When two balls with the same number touch they merge instantly: 2+2→4, 4+4→8… all the way to 2048!
tutorial.drop2048.end_desc: The game ends when a column is full and the next ball can't be placed. Watch column heights and spread your drops evenly.
tutorial.block.goal_desc: Place block pieces onto the grid to fill complete rows or columns. Clear lines to score — survive as long as possible!
tutorial.block.place_desc: Drag a piece from the tray at the bottom onto an empty area of the board. Invalid spots are highlighted in red.
tutorial.block.clear_desc: Filling multiple rows or columns simultaneously triggers a combo for bonus points. Plan placements to maximise clears!
tutorial.block.end_desc: When none of the tray pieces can fit anywhere on the board, the game ends. Keep lines clear to preserve space!
tutorial.lightsout.goal_desc: Turn off every light on the board (all cells go dark). When the board is completely unlit, you win!
tutorial.lightsout.toggle_desc: Clicking a light toggles it AND its four orthogonal neighbours simultaneously. This is the core mechanic!
tutorial.lightsout.logic_desc: Every puzzle has an exact solution where each cell is clicked at most once. Extra clicks just undo your progress.
tutorial.lightsout.hint_desc: Stuck? Tap 💡 to highlight the next recommended cell to click and get back on track.

sliding.desc: Classic 15-Puzzle. Slide the tiles to order them sequentially.
sliding.rules.title: How to Play Sliding Puzzle
sliding.rules.1: The board consists of numbered tiles and one empty space.
sliding.rules.2: Click a tile adjacent to the empty space to slide it into the space.
sliding.rules.3: Arrange all numbers in sequential order (1, 2, 3...) from top-left to bottom-right.
sliding.rules.4: The bottom-right corner must be the empty space at the end.
sliding.rules.5: In PK mode, everyone gets the exact same shuffled board. The first to solve it wins!

tutorial.nonogram.goal_desc: Fill cells based on hints to reveal the picture.
tutorial.nonogram.hints_desc: Numbers indicate consecutive filled cells in that row/col.
tutorial.nonogram.fill_desc: Click a cell to fill it.

game.nonogram.seo_desc:
About Nonogram

Nonogram is a classic logic puzzle game where you use number clues to reveal a hidden pixel art picture.

How to Play

The numbers on the edges indicate the lengths of consecutive filled cells in that row or column. Use cross-referencing to logically deduce which cells must be filled or left blank.

Features

  • Multiple grid sizes (5x5, 10x10, 15x15) for all skill levels.
  • All puzzles are uniquely solvable by pure logic.
  • Compete with others online in Speed mode!
